latest.title: Trisection invariants of 4-manifolds are uncomputable
latest.abstract: We prove that two invariants of smooth 4-manifolds defined in terms of trisections are uncomputable: the trisection genus and the Kirby-Thompson L-invariant. That is, there does not exist an algorithm that takes as input a triangulated closed orientable 4-manifold and outputs one of these quantities. The result on the L-invariant resolves the second part of Problem 4.116 in the K3 problem list. In the same spirit, we show that the PL multisection genus of PL manifolds is uncomputable in dimensions at least four.
latest.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
latest.workSummary: 证明输入闭、连通、可定向四维流形的 PL 三角剖分时，三分解亏格与 Kirby–Thompson L 不变量不存在通用精确计算算法；并将 PL 多分解亏格的不可计算性扩展至所有维数 n≥4。
latest.breakthrough: 为流形分解复杂度建立原则性算法障碍，回答 K3 问题表 4.116 的第二部分；结论不是算法慢，而是不存在对所有输入终止的精确算法。
latest.limitations: 并不排除特定流形类或给定分解的有效算法。给定三分解的 cut complex 距离是否可计算仍未解决；高维结论使用 PL 类别及有限三角剖分输入。
latest.priorityReason: 问题明确、证明路线紧凑且算法含义广，适合作为几何拓扑组会的高优先级短文；对实际计算项目的边界设定尤其重要。
